description: Deterministic live GitHub pull-request readiness checks used immediately before merge or auto-merge decisions.

checks.behavior_explanation: A pull request targeting main must have the same repository's release/local as its source.
The PR state is OPEN before a merge or auto-merge decision.
The PR is not marked draft unless the workflow intentionally stops before merge.
The PR is MERGEABLE. CONFLICTING is an error; unknown or delayed mergeability is a warning requiring fresh live state.
No blocking review decision is present unless direct admin merge is explicitly authorized and the only review blocker is REVIEW_REQUIRED. Requested changes always block direct merge.

Visible status checks are passing for direct merge. Failing checks block; explicitly pending checks require auto-merge or the configured wait. An empty rollup is accepted only when applicable branch protection and rulesets require no status checks. The validator reports missing required checks and unclassifiable entries; merge and ship workflows own any bounded retry before blocking.
Auto-merge is configured only when GitHub should wait for remaining requirements. Absence is a warning, not a direct-merge blocker.

approved_drift.condition: The current workflow intends an immediate direct merge after required gates are satisfied.
approved_drift.approval: Treat missing auto-merge as approved drift for direct-merge workflows.

approved_drift.condition: The workflow is intentionally enabling auto-merge while checks are still pending.
approved_drift.approval: Pending checks are acceptable only when auto-merge is used and no failing checks are present.
